_doc: Verdict rows of B03: C01-C23 are the lead's rows (R04), never edited; C24 and after are added. Each arm is a literal `comparable` document and may add `init_tools` (the measured census.init_tools list; null = unrecorded; "skip" = none added), `claimed` (the arm's own factors[], never trusted), `outside` (manifest fields outside the hash) the flags unsorted_values and dup_snapshots, and `provenance` (overrides of the clean provenance block every arm is given, keyed by the path after `provenance.`; null = unrecorded). `declared` is the experiment file's factor set. `expected` is `comparable`, `{"refused": [paths]}` or `malformed`.

rows.source: R01 I7: "The diff of comparability fields proves it" (an empty diff)
I7: "Arms differ only in declared treatment factors"
R01 Error model: "Arms differ outside declared factors: the stratum is invalid; comparisons are refused"
Error model, same row; a declared factor never covers a second diff
R01 Run manifest: "Outside the hash: sources[], secrets[], measured[], deviations[], timestamps, host, job id and the attempt"
I7 (a sibling path is not a declared factor)
I7; a prefix of characters is not a prefix of path segments (plan verifier attack)
R01 Experiment file: "A level is a value, or a table that fills the values under its path"
R01 Run manifest `comparable.treatment`; I7
I7
R01 Run manifest `comparable.harness`; Resume: "a harness that auto-updated"
R01 Run manifest `comparable.snapshots`; plan D9
R01 Run manifest `comparable.inputs`
R01 Run manifest: "isolation under `isolation.*`"; plan field paths
R01 Budget: per-run caps are "a treatment condition, the same for every arm"
R01 Run manifest: "A value without `value` was `unrecorded`"
R01 Run manifest: job caps and `replicates` are operational settings that never enter `comparable`
I7; a lying `factors[]` never proves comparability (plan verifier attack)
R01 Run manifest: "A reader refuses one that is not" (sorted and without duplicates); here an unsorted `values`

Plan D9 (only `init_tools` is the hook): `census.mcp_servers` differs, `census.init_tools` equal
Ruled (F5): a declared factor under `tools.*` or `mcp.*` exempts `census.init_tools`
Ruled (F5): only a `tools.*` or `mcp.*` factor exempts it
I7; two declared factors do not cover a third path: `model.endpoint` drifts beside two declared ones
I7; a declared path longer than the diff covers nothing: `model.id.x` is below `model.id`
Error model: a three-arm stratum is refused when only the third arm drifts outside the declared factors
R01 Run manifest: "A reader refuses one that is not" (without duplicates); a repeated `snapshots` entry in one arm only
I7; a declared parent covers every value below it (and the control for C06)
I7; the nuisance set is for manifest fields: a comparable value named like one (`host.name`) is still a drift
I7; a declared `tools.*` factor that does not vary exempts nothing: only `census.init_tools` differs
Ruled (F5): the exemption is the first segment `tools` or `mcp`, not a character prefix (`toolsx`)
R01 Session runner (I7): a tool list recorded in one arm and not in the other differs
I7; the tool list is compared in its recorded order (a reordered list is a different list)
R01 Run manifest `comparable.harness`; a driver recorded in one arm only is a difference
Error model; a value held by one arm only is a difference, and a declared factor covers it
I7; the same value-absent difference under a declared factor
R01 Run manifest: "A value without `value` was `unrecorded`"; unrecorded in both arms is no difference (the control for C16)
Error model; paths are named sorted and once: two drifting arms share `model.endpoint`
I7; a value at a root the typed fields own (`treatment.tag`) is malformed, not a hidden second treatment
R01 Run manifest; `census.init_tools` measured twice in one arm has no single value, so the arm is malformed
I7; a stratum of one arm has nothing to differ from
I7; a stratum with no arm has no verdict
Ruled (F5), I7: two arms that agree on every varying declared mcp.* factor must agree on census.init_tools (arm 1 differs from both, arms 2 and 3 agree on mcp.x but not on the tool list)
Ruled (F5): positive control of C43; arms 2 and 3 agree on mcp.x and on the tool list
A55 (F9): a run built from a dirty tree (`provenance.eval_infra.dirty` true) refuses its stratum
A55 (F9): `provenance.eval_infra.dirty` unrecorded refuses the stratum as a dirty tree does
A55 (F9): one dirty run among clean ones refuses the stratum
A55 (F9): runs that differ in `provenance.eval_infra.commit` are refused
A55 (F9): runs that differ in `provenance.sandbox_contract` are refused
D8: `provenance.eval_infra.tag` is descriptive: recorded in one run and unrecorded in another, the commit being equal, the stratum stays comparable
D8: the provenance a verdict ignores (`skill_version`, `planner.*`) does not gate: runs differing only in them stay comparable
A55 (F9): clean runs that agree on the whole block are comparable (positive control of C45 to C50)
D8: `provenance.eval_infra.commit` unrecorded in every arm refuses the stratum and names it: an unrecorded commit never counts as equal
D8: `provenance.eval_infra.commit` recorded in one arm and unrecorded in the other refuses the stratum
D8: `provenance.eval_infra.tag` differs and the commit is equal: descriptive, comparable (a git build and a crates.io build of one commit pool)
D8: `provenance.eval_infra.commits_ahead` differs and the commit is equal: descriptive, comparable
D8: `provenance.packages.*` describes a run and gates nothing: differing distribution and version are comparable
D8: `provenance.eval_infra.commit` and `dirty` both unrecorded in every arm: both are named, sorted
D8: a tag that differs together with a commit that differs: only the commit is named
D8: refused paths are named sorted whatever the order they are found in: `census.init_tools` precedes the unrecorded commit
D8: a path is named once when two checks refuse it: the commit differs between arms 1 and 2 and is unrecorded in arm 3, beside a dirty arm
D8: `provenance.sandbox_contract` unrecorded in every arm refuses the stratum: an unrecorded gated field never counts as equal
D8: an empty `provenance.eval_infra.commit`, identical across arms, is unrecorded and refused
D7: two imported arms with the same import.rules, legacy commit, dirty flag (true) and contract are comparable; a dirty legacy build pools
D7: imported arms that differ only in a declared factor are comparable
D7: the measured[] provenance gate is swapped out for an imported stratum: measured provenance values that would refuse a live stratum gate nothing
D7: imported arms read with different import.rules are refused, naming import.rules
D7: one arm of three read with other import.rules refuses the stratum, naming import.rules
D7: import.rules absent in every arm is refused (None is not equal to None), naming import.rules
D7: import.rules absent in one arm is refused, naming import.rules
D7: a legacy commit unrecorded in comparable.values in every arm is refused, naming the path
D7: a legacy commit that is an empty string identifies no build, so it is unrecorded and refused
D7: a legacy dirty flag unrecorded in comparable.values in every arm is refused, naming the path
D7: a legacy sandbox contract unrecorded in comparable.values in every arm is refused, naming the path
D7: a dirty legacy build pools only with arms of the same commit: two dirty arms of different commits are refused, naming provenance.eval_infra.commit
D7: a dirty legacy build pools only with arms of the same flag: one dirty and one clean arm of one commit are refused, naming provenance.eval_infra.dirty
D7: imported arms of different legacy sandbox contracts are refused, naming provenance.sandbox_contract
D7: a stratum mixing an imported arm and a live arm is refused, naming import
D7: a mixed stratum is refused whichever arm comes first, naming import
D7: an imported arm whose record holds no legacy build values, as a raw-trace import has, is refused, naming the three unrecorded legacy paths
D8 unchanged: live arms with no import record and a dirty measured build are refused, as every live stratum is
